<?php
// Create wp_collaboration table
global $wpdb;
$wpdb->query("
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS {$wpdb->prefix}collaboration (
        id bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
        room varchar(191) NOT NULL,
        type varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL,
        data longtext NOT NULL,
        timestamp bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY (id),
        UNIQUE KEY room_type (room(191), type),
        KEY room_id (room(50), id),
        KEY room_timestamp (room(50), timestamp)
    ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
");
echo 'wp_collaboration table created';

<?php
// Verify all plugins are active
$plugins = ['presence-api/presence-api.php', 'gutenberg/gutenberg.php', 'sync-storage/sync-storage.php'];
foreach ($plugins as $plugin) {
    if (!is_plugin_active($plugin)) {
        activate_plugin($plugin);
    }
}
